interpretation.baseline_comparison: Full Multi-Expert improved labeled detection and repair coverage over the rule baseline in this suite.
interpretation.router_limitation: Broad NumericExpert and CategoricalExpert activation caused low precision, high false routing, and zero clean routing no-op accuracy.
interpretation.oracle_result: Oracle routing produced 0.9806 mean detection F1, indicating routing selectivity is the largest measured opportunity.
interpretation.critic_arbiter_limitation: Removing Critic or Arbiter did not change aggregate natural-scenario repair; controlled unsafe/conflict fixtures demonstrated their safety behavior.
